'''Merici''' is a performer in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].

==Appearance==
[[Olver]], who is taken with Merici, says that her eyes are the prettiest he has ever seen. He makes the same statement about [[Neilyn]].{{ref/book|9|15}}

==Activities==
Merici is one of several women who have taken an interest in Olver. When he leaves the show with [[Matrim Cauthon]], Olver spends time with Merici, [[Adria]], [[Gillin]], [[Jameine]] and Neilyn.{{ref/book|9|15}}
